links.outcome: LLM concordance score variation across prompt language and role variants
links.effect: ChatGPT scored highest on Korean-doctor prompts (mean 0.98, SD 0.82), while Clova X scored lowest on English-patient prompts (mean 0.23, SD 0.63), showing large performance differences by prompt variant.
links.quote: Clova X recorded the lowest mean score on English-patient prompts (mean 0.23, SD 0.63).

unlisted_practices: Comparing LLM diagnostic screening accuracy against dental clinicians of varying experience levels
Role-based prompt engineering (doctor vs patient persona)

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the performance of LLMs compared with human dental clinicians and students on 100 endodontic clinical cases using image-free records without testing a deployment safeguard or workflow practice.
